تواعدت (form VI)
# تَوَاعَدْتُ (tawāʕadtu) /ta.waː.ʕad.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَاعَدَ (tawāʕada)
# تَوَاعَدْتَ (tawāʕadta) /ta.waː.ʕad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَاعَدَ (tawāʕada)
# تَوَاعَدْتِ (tawāʕadti) /ta.waː.ʕad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَاعَدَ (tawāʕada)
# تَوَاعَدَتْ (tawāʕadat) /ta.waː.ʕa.dat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
